title: Pinned-release IO invariants and onboarding SLA
creator: Priya Shah
description: Goal: Produce a small, audited contract that every pinned model release must satisfy before being marked 'pinned' in the model catalog. The contract covers three pillars: IO invariants (prompt shape, tokenization expectations, structured output schema), parameter surface stability (allowed ranges and semantics for temperature, top_p, max_tokens, stop sequences), and published performance profile (latency P50/P95, tokens/sec under standard batch profiles, memory footprint). Deliverables: onboarding checklist, machine-checkable regression harness, human-readable compatibility statement, and a short rollout playbook with automatic fallback policies.
acceptance_criteria: A machine-readable 'pinned-release-manifest' JSON schema exists and is checked in the onboarding repo
Onboarding CI runs a deterministic I/O regression suite (10 canonical prompts) and fails if tokenization or structured output shape changes exceed thresholds
Performance profile published for P50/P95 latency and tokens/sec at batch sizes 1, 8, 32; guidelines for quantized variants included
Parameter contract documents allowed parameter ranges and a mapping for deprecated parameters; SDKs enforce parameter validation for pinned models
A minimal 'compatibility statement' artifact is generated per pinned release and surfaced in the model catalog UI and API
Rollout playbook with canary sizes (1%, 10%, 100%) and automatic downgrade triggers exists and is linked from the release manifest
Security review sign-off recorded for any model whose outputs may include PII-sensitive formatting or new capabilities
implementation_steps: Draft JSON schema for pinned-release-manifest (io_schema, params_guardrails, perf_profile)
Extend onboarding CI: add tokenization diff checker and structured-output shape comparator
Define canonical prompt set (10 prompts) covering edge cases: trailing spaces, non-UTF8, large context, function-calling scenarios
Integrate perf benchmarks into nightly runners and capture P50/P95 and tokens/sec
Add SDK validation layer that reads pinned-release-manifest and enforces parameter bounds at client-side
Design model-catalog UI card to display compatibility statement and perf profile
Create rollout playbook and automate simple fallback to compatible variant when regression detected
